text: A scourge is something that causes great suffering over a wide area. Here, rabies has hurt people in many countries for ages.
To grapple with a problem is to struggle with it and keep trying to solve it. The word comes from wrestling, where you grip your opponent.
Daunting means so big or hard that it makes you feel nervous. Millions of stray dogs make the job look daunting.
Sterilisation here means an operation on an animal so it cannot have babies. That keeps the number of dogs from growing.
To neuter an animal is to do a small operation so it cannot have puppies.
Rabies is a deadly disease caused by a virus. Dogs can pass it to people through a bite.
Vaccination means giving a shot that teaches the body to fight a germ, so it cannot catch the disease.
A stray dog has no home or owner and wanders the streets.
A mutt is a dog that is a mix of different breeds, not one special kind.
Notched means having a small cut or nick taken out of the edge. Here, a little piece is cut from a dog's ear as a mark.
Laced with means mixed with something secretly, usually something harmful. Here, the meat had poison hidden in it.
Strychnine is a deadly poison. People once used it to kill animals.
Marksmen are people who are very good at shooting. They aim carefully.
Appalled means shocked and upset by something wrong or cruel.
Patchy means uneven, good in some places and missing in others. The program worked in some areas but not others.
Implementation is the act of carrying out a plan. A good plan still fails if it is carried out badly.
Transmission is how a disease passes from one animal or person to another.
A decree is an official order from a ruler. Here, the king ordered the whole country to act.
Humane means kind and caring, without needless pain. A humane plan treats animals gently.
Compassionate means feeling sorry for someone's suffering and wanting to help.
Free-roaming means wandering around without an owner or fence.
A corps is an organized group of people working together. These volunteers worked without pay.
A rabid animal is sick with rabies, so its bite can pass on the disease.

t: give the campaign bite as well as bark
text: This plays on the saying "his bark is worse than his bite." The campaign had plenty of talk, and the decree gave it real power to act.
Himalayan means from the Himalayas, the tallest mountain range in the world, north of India.
